headline: Pakistan Cricket Board Updates Central Contracts For Key Players
seoTitle: Pakistan Cricket Board Central Contracts Update
metaDescription: The Pakistan Cricket Board has introduced a new format-based central contract system, removing Mohammad Rizwan and Shan Masood while retaining others.
aiSummaryBullets: The Pakistan Cricket Board has implemented a new, format-based system for national player contracts.
Former team captains Mohammad Rizwan and Shan Masood have been excluded from the latest list of central contracts.
Babar Azam and Salman Agha remain part of the updated structure under the new administrative approach.
aiContextParagraph: The Pakistan Cricket Board has officially announced a significant restructuring of its central contract system for national cricketers. This transition introduces a format-based framework, which replaces the previous method of centralizing player agreements. As part of this comprehensive administrative overhaul, notable changes were made to the personnel receiving central status. Specifically, former team captains Mohammad Rizwan and Shan Masood have been omitted from the new list of central contracts. In contrast, the board has confirmed the continued inclusion of senior players Babar Azam and Salman Agha. These decisions reflect the board's new strategy to refine the contractual hierarchy within the national team, shifting the focus towards specific playing formats. This move marks a major shift in how the organization manages its professional roster and internal development policies for the upcoming season.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent media outlets, reflecting significant interest in the administrative changes impacting the national cricket team.
